name: Kansai Nerolac Paints Ltd
title: Kansai Nerolac Paints Ltd - 500165 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 paints call: management is passing through steep crude-led inflation with decorative price hikes of about 2% in March then 5-6% per step (higher single digit net), but no volume hit yet and no capacity expansion signalled. Margin guide 13-14% held.

utilisation.quote: We should be operating about 70% to 75% as of now.

capex.quote: When it comes to capex, the capex is more or less normal and in line with previous years.

triggers.label: Deco price hikes ~higher single digit net
triggers.quote: So net -net, I would say we'll be higher single digit as far as price increase is concerned in decorative as of now.

triggers.label: Volume impact from hikes: none seen yet
triggers.quote: As of now, frankly, there is no impact we have seen.

triggers.label: FY27 EBIT-type margin 13-14% endeavour
triggers.quote: like historically, we have been talking about 13% to 14%. I think that is what the endeavor is.

guidance.quote: like historically, we have been talking about 13% to 14%. I think that is what the endeavor is.

red_flags.label: Volume-value gap: deliberate SKU cuts in deco
red_flags.quote: So we have cautiously curtailed our sale into items which are not profitable.

red_flags.label: Other expenses down 150bps YoY, explanation thin
red_flags.quote: because of fuel increase, you're seeing the drop out there.

evasions.quote: In auto, it's very difficult, Avi. You'll appreciate that.
Sorry. We can't -- not able to understand the question.
So our endeavor is to neutralize, though some impact cannot be ruled out.
